purpose: Address Fable R10 Alt-A critique: is the low rho an artifact of the 11-bin projection?
protocol: Same 50-cell code arithmetic, 12 conditions. Two readouts: (1) 11-bin TV (digit probabilities), (2) Full logit cosine distance (~151K dimensions for Qwen, ~49K for SmolLM2).
interpretation: 11-bin projection underestimates transfer by ~2x (captures only task-relevant dimensions)
Full-logit rho (0.25-0.68) is still below biology (0.88-0.98)
Task-specific information (digits) shows LOWER transfer than general behavior
This means: general behavioral similarity under test conditions does NOT predict task-specific performance under novel conditions
The component of behavior most relevant for evaluation/safety (getting the right answer) is precisely what transfers least
